MRT-3.source: dotr mrt-3 citizen's charter brochure (dotrmrt3.gov.ph/dotr-mrt3-brochure.pdf): fare matrix (regular, 13 to 28 pesos, same-station entry and exit 13) and discounted fare matrix (20 percent, 10 to 22 pesos). matches the dotr-mrt3 fare matrix sheet sent with the group's data request (regular passenger, 4 january 2015 to 22 march 2026).

LRT-1.source: lrt-1 fare matrix effective 2 april 2025 (lrmc fare adjustment approved by dotr; single journey 20 to 55 pesos, stored value 16 to 52), covering the 25 stations including the cavite extension (redemptorist-aseana, mia road, pitx, ninoy aquino ave, dr. santos). typed from the station-to-station tables republished by expressway.ph and mypinas.ph; the two agree on 599 of 600 cells (mypinas lists libertad to blumentritt beep as 30 one way, 29 the other; the symmetric 29 is used). roosevelt lrt is fernando poe jr. station. confirm against lrmc's own sheet when available.
LRT-1.note: matrix = single journey ticket; stored_value_matrix = beep card. same-station entries use the minimum fare (20 single journey, 16 stored value). replaces the 2 august 2023 matrix (15 to 35 pesos, 20 stations).

LRT-2.source: lrt-1: lrmc fare matrix graphics effective 2 august 2023 as republished by top gear philippines (1 august 2023). lrt-2: the lrta single journey and stored value matrices sent with the lrta foi response (tracking LRTA-315199311699, 10 july 2026), which correct three cells of the top gear graphic. typed from the graphics. the engine prices with the single journey ticket fares; the stored value (beep) fares are kept for reference. the 20 percent student, senior citizen and pwd discount is applied by the engine after the lookup.
LRT-2.note: matrix = single journey ticket; stored_value_matrix = beep card. same-station entries use the minimum fare (15 single journey, 13 stored value).
